notes:
Account summary:
- Enterprise logistics SaaS building real-time routing + SLA-aware ETA for carriers. Heavy multimodal pipeline: chat ops for dispatch, high-frequency embeddings for route similarity, reranking for candidate legs.
- Interested in Redwood Dedicated with optional Private VPC for production sensitive lanes. Will consider on-prem for EU regulated work.
- Primary ask: firm throughput guarantee for peak season (holiday spikes) + predictable unit economics.

Timeline / recent activity:
- 2025-11-03: Intro call (Maya + Jordan). High level requirements captured. Fireflies: ff_2026-01-12_arboreal_intro.
- 2025-12-10: Architecture deep-dive with infra + security. Discussed VPC, KMS, and audit log retention (Ravi + security).
- 2026-01-18: POC kickoff (mini-sandbox). Small GPU cluster on Dedicated; baseline test with vicuna-13b-8k quantized model.
- 2026-02-08: Mid-POC results: steady-state throughput ~22k tokens/sec on test workload (1k concurrent short chats), 95p latency 280ms under 256-token requests. Recorded RDW-3452.
- 2026-02-16: Scale POC run (full concurrency profile). Burst scenarios exercised; recorded ff_2026-02-16_poc-review.
- 2026-02-24: Pricing & SLA draft shared (drive link). Legal requested clearer penalty for missed min tokens/sec guarantee. RDW-3621 opened for kernel/quantization tuning requests.

Technical requirements (negotiation focus):
- Throughput guarantee: customer asks for minimum sustained throughput of 25,000 tokens/sec across dedicated pool measured as 5-minute rolling average. Redwood proposed 20,000 tokens/sec with 99.9% uptime over billing period.
- Concurrency caps: target concurrent request headroom of 800 active short-chat sessions (avg 40 tokens outbound per turn), with autoscale policy to preserve latency SLOs.
- Burst policy: allow bursts up to 2x baseline (40k tokens/sec) for up to 10 minutes per hour without immediate throttling; sustained bursts beyond that subject to negotiated overage pricing. Customer requests a 3-minute grace window before throttling for sudden spikes.
- Latency SLOs: 95th percentile < 300ms for requests <= 256 tokens; 99th percentile < 900ms for mixed-length (up to 2k tokens) reranking jobs.
- Measurement & telemetry: must rely on token-metered counters + per-route latency histograms accessible in Console and via exported traces. Customer requests daily delta reports and a monthly SLA report.
- Fallback & routing: require automatic fallback to smaller quantized variants for latency-critical traffic with no functional regression >2% on BLEU-like rerank metric.
- Capacity planning: proposed dedicated pool = 12 x A100-equivalent GPUs with reserved baseline and 4x burst nodes on separate capacity tier. Customer wants clear mapping from tokens/sec -> GPU count per model variant.
- Penalties: customer requests service credits tied to missed min tokens/sec for a monthly window: 10% credit if sustained <90% of guaranteed throughput, 25% credit if <75%. Legal pushing back; Redwood requests detailed incident RCA before payouts.

POC findings & engineering notes:
- Quantization and KV cache tuning improved throughput by ~18% vs baseline. SE noted kernel-level knob that benefits routing workloads (logged to RDW-3452).
- Prefix caching for frequent route queries reduces effective tokens generated per request by ~12% in production-like trace. Good ROI for both parties.
- Observed tail latency spikes during cold-cache starts; suggestion: warm-up policy + prefetch KV entries for top 500 routes.

Commercial / procurement items:
- Proposed commit: 12 reserved GPUs, 24/7 priority capacity, 12-month term, estimated ARR $350k. Forecast: 2026-04 close.
- Open negotiation items: definitive throughput SLA numbers, burst pricing tiers, incident credit triggers, and EU data residency addendum for on-prem option.

Next steps (short):
- 03/14: Full-scale load test scheduled (Jordan + Arboreal infra) to validate 25k tokens/sec sustained for 1 hour. Action: SE to run capacity plan and produce tokens/sec->GPU mapping.
- Week of 03/24: Legal to exchange SLA redline; AE to coordinate.
- 04/01: Exec review + procurement sign-off meeting (tentative).
